text:
Dawson Mercer spent his first 410 NHL games in New Jersey, the 18th pick in 2020 out of Chicoutimi. Now he's a Jet, and his first goal for Winnipeg, the winner in a 6-2 win over Vancouver on Nov. 5, came 17 games into the season. It helped end a seven-game losing streak that hung over the whole team.

The drought was bad luck more than bad play. He has 33 shots and 3.48 expected goals from his own looks, and one goal to show for it: 3 percent shooting from a player who usually sits near 12. His 5v5 shot share is good (55.9 percent of attempts) and he's 5.7 points better than his teammates by chance share.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him on the end of plenty of slot passes last season, and our numbers flag him as due. His wins-added rank (457th of 499) only tells you nothing has gone in yet. Our range expects about 15 goals the rest of the way.
headline: Mercer's fresh start in Winnipeg
